trips.route_note: Fast ferries cross the Sea of Marmara to Mudanya/Yalova, then a local bus or minibus continues to Bursa; alternatively direct intercity buses run from Istanbul.
trips.why: Direct intercity buses reach Bursa in about 3 hours, and the ferry-plus-bus option also works well.
know: Allow a full day for Ulu Cami, the bazaar and Cumalıkızık village
The ferry across the Marmara is a scenic alternative to the bus
Book return seats in advance on weekends

bus.via: İstanbul Esenler bus station to Edirne bus station

trips.route_note: Take a direct regional bus or a bus/train combination west toward the Bulgarian border; buses run direct from Istanbul's main otogars in about 2.5-3 hours.
trips.why: The direct bus takes under 3 hours and drops you in the city center, far faster than the 7-hour train.
know: Selimiye Mosque is the star sight; allow a full day
Buses leave from Esenler otogar on the western edge of the city
Very hot in midsummer; spring and autumn are best

trips.route_note: High-speed trains from Istanbul to Sapanca take about 1.5-2 hours, with the station a short minibus or taxi ride from the lake.
trips.tour_query: Sapanca lake day trip from Istanbul
trips.why: Public transport is impractical here: the train takes over 3 hours and the bus over 5, so an organized tour is the sensible choice.
know: The lake and forest walks are the main attractions
Weekends are crowded with Istanbul day-trippers
Spring and autumn offer the best weather

trips.route_note: Take a fast ferry from Yenikapı or Kabataş directly across the Marmara to Yalova, then local minibuses reach Termal and the coast.
trips.tour_query: Yalova Termal day trip from Istanbul
trips.why: A fast, frequent bus gets you there in about 1.5 hours, and local minibuses reach Termal and the coast.
know: Termal's hot springs are the main draw
Ferries from Yenikapı or Kabataş are a pleasant alternative
Best in spring and autumn; the coast is busy in summer
